regions.today: A mix of sunny spells and scattered cloud this morning. Dry weather mostly too with more sunshine arriving later this afternoon. Westerly breezes and highs of 17 to 20 degrees.
regions.tonight: A mix of cloud and clear spells this evening but overnight the cloud will clear away. Dry weather too with light winds and lows with some light patchy drizzle lingering in the northwest. Staying mostly dry further south with lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Generally becoming cloudier from later in the morning but it will stay largely dry with light westerly winds and highs of 20 to 23 degrees.
